name: @khorsheed/dsh-eval-tool
description: The session-granted eval read tools, companion to @khorsheed/dsh-eval: a tool-only row (provides no service) that agent presets compose to grant eval_conditions / eval_plan_validate / eval_run_status / eval_cells (`tools`: all / none) per session, plus their tool-guidance prompt section. Deliberately NOT self-mounting — installing it as a dependency only makes the module resolvable; an agent preset's agent.cordis.yml references the row by name.

compat.notes: Host-plane companion row: provides no service, registers the four read-only eval tools into the host tools registry and contributes the `tool:eval` prompt section, so agent presets may compose it bare (the official tool-row shape). Probes the global `ctx.dshEval` service at apply time and silently skips registration when the core plugin is absent — a preset naming this row still mounts cleanly. No browser half: this package has no browser surface at all.
